# logparser

A scala script that retrieves logs from S3 cloud and populates the mongodb.

## Build & Run ##

```sh
$ cd logparser
$ ./sbt
> docker
```

To run the docker image:

```sh
docker run -ti jiborobot/logparser
```

To pass the proper external mongo:

```
docker run -it --link some-mongo:mongo -e ETCO_server_mongoHost="ip1:27018,ip2:27018,ip3:27018" -e ETCO_server_mongoReplicaName="s-1-rs0" --name logparser jiborobot/logparser
```
